posts.title: Security Week 2026
posts.description: Busy week. Bryan came to me at like 11pm mentioning that Go had rotated a CA. eMudhra — a certificate authority whose private keys turned out to be the number 4. I’ve heard a few theories - they misinterpreted P-384 or P-256, they might’ve been trained on a different HSM. PHP2Shell — Data race to a UAF. Discussed years ago but thought non-exploitable. Discovered by Calif and then Amy. Brotli2Shell

posts.title: Lean partiality and EML
posts.description: I got very curious about the EML paper . The idea there is eml(x,y) = exp(x) - ln(y), and trees of this and the constant 1 can implement ~36 of the elementary functions sin(x) etc. It’s a bit like boolean logic gates for elementary functions. I tried implementing it in Lean but ran into a limitation wherein Lean requires total functions, and some math functions are partial (e.g. ln(0) = 0 in Lean)
